changelog:
Initial release of Pet First Aid & Emergency Care.

- Provides emergency triage guidance to help users decide when a pet needs urgent veterinary attention.
- Offers step-by-step instructions for assessing vital signs in dogs and cats.
- Includes basic wound care protocols for minor injuries.
- Covers first aid for poisoning, choking, burns, heatstroke, and other common emergencies.
- Lists region-specific emergency numbers and resources for affordable vet care.
- Built for practical, real-world situations faced by pet owners.
